Stanbic IBTC Enhanced Short-Term Fixed Income Fund

Highlights
  • The Stanbic IBTC Enhanced Short-Term Fixed Income (SEFI) was launched in February 2021
  • The Fund invests 100% of its portfolio in fixed income Fund instruments (such as Treasury Bills, Commercial Papers, Fixed Deposits, Short Term Debt Instruments e.t.c.) 
  • The Fund has a 90-day minimum holding period
  • The penalty for redeeming within the minimum holding period is 20% on the accrued income
  • The minimum investment amount is N5,000.00
  • The fund is an open-ended unit trust scheme 
  • The risk profile for the fund is “Moderately Aggressive”
  • The management fee is 1.25% per annum
